---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea — a new provider, a pipeline stage, an API shape
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the gap or friction you're running into.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see happen. If it's a new provider adapter, name the
vendor and link its API docs. If it's a pipeline change, note which stage
(`extract_claims`, `compare_sources`, `web_verify`, `contradictions`,
`scoring`) it affects.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems better.

**Additional context**
Anything else — links, examples from other tools, etc.
